title: Warm Crunchy Croatian Peanut Brittle Toast
description: A nostalgic Croatian dish featuring peanut brittle, toast, and a touch of saltiness. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat your molcajete over medium heat on the stovetop.
Place the slices of bread inside the preheated molcajete and toast for 2 minutes on each side.
Remove the toasted bread from the molcajete and place it on a plate.
Melt the unsalted butter in the molcajete over low heat.
Add the peanut brittle to the molcajete and stir until it's evenly coated with the melted butter.
Sprinkle the peanut brittle mixture over the toasted bread.
Season with kosher salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
